patches.name: Flyme status bar lyrics
patches.description: Requires Third-party lyrics and Show mini-player lyrics from the official Morphe source. Mirrors the mini-player lyric text to Flyme.

release_notes:
Independent Flyme add-on: this source now contains only **Flyme status bar lyrics**.

In the same patching run, select **Third-party lyrics from the OFFICIAL Morphe source** and **Flyme status bar lyrics from this source**. Enable the official third-party lyrics setting and **Show mini-player lyrics**. The add-on reads the official mini-player text, so the official mini-player lyrics switch is required. Missing official hooks produce an explicit patch error; Morphe cannot auto-select dependencies across sources.

Validation: notification behavior tests, integration against the unmodified official v2.1.0 extension DEX, DEX round-trip and dexdump, full Android compilation, and checks that no official patches or extensions are bundled. Real Flyme device and full YT Music APK patch/install verification are still required.
repoDescription: Community patch source for Flyme status bar lyrics in YouTube Music, using official Morphe third-party lyrics
